ideas.name: a wide signal bar (2-minute range >= 1.4 one-minute ATRs)
ideas.why: a breakout on a wide bar is urgent buying (selling); a narrow one drifts through the level

ideas.name: no losing trade earlier today
ideas.why: a failed breakout earlier says the day rotates; the next one meets the same sellers (buyers)

ideas.name: beyond the 30-minute opening range
ideas.why: the opening range is the day's first auction; a break beyond it has the open's losers' stops behind it

ideas.name: the opening gap points the trade's way
ideas.why: an RTH open above yesterday's close (long) is overnight demand still being worked

ideas.name: beyond the overnight high (long) / low (short)
ideas.why: the overnight extremes hold the night's stops; breaking them brings that flow

ideas.name: a trend day: half an ADR from the open its way
ideas.why: a day already half a normal range from its open the trade's way is a trend day; breakouts with it keep going

ideas.name: the 5m EMA row not warning toward the trade
ideas.why: confirmed #5: a 5m warning is a continuation sign, so one pointing toward the trade means the 5m trend against it continues

ideas.name: volatility expanding: 5m ATR above an hour ago
ideas.why: an expanding range is new information arriving; breakouts in it follow through, in contraction they fade
